Part IV (B) – GAZETTE   EXTRAORDINARY   OF   THE   DEMOCRATIC   SOCIALIST   REPUBLIC   OF   SRI   LANKA – 26.11.2019
NOTICE  UNDER  SECTION  10A(1)(a) OF  THE  LOCAL  AUTHORITIES  ELECTIONS  ORDINANCE

column1: I,  Sajith  Wasantha  Welgama,  Returning  Officer  of  the  Mawanella  Pradeshiya  Sabha,  do  hereby  declare  under  Section
10A(1)(a) of the (Chapter 262) Local Authorities Elections Ordinance that Mr. Karapane Mahaarachchilalage Chandrasiri
Bandara of the Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of  member of that Pradeshiya Sabha as he ceased to be
a member of the United People’s Freedom Alliance.
